scope: Adapter TagDuel isolado para dois efeitos FLIP de dano baseado em estado atual do oponente. Gatilho somente em Flip Summon real; Des Koala conta a mão privada do representante adversário ativo no momento da resolução; Princess conta backrow + Field Zone do time adversário. Preserva controlador atual, proprietário físico, LP compartilhado e zonas.

conflictCheck.result: No overlap in card identities or reserved paths; work isolated to four new files.

cards.name: Des Koala
cards.officialText: FLIP: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand.

cards.name: Princess of Tsurugi
cards.officialText: FLIP: Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each Spell and Trap Card on your opponent's side of the field.

design.trigger: Event requires explicit flip-summon, wasFaceDown=true, faceUp=true, current turn and source still face-up in Attack Position when queued; effect flips do not trigger.
design.desKoala: Count only the private hand of the opposing team's currently active seat at resolution; a 7th card is counted and is not discarded until End Phase.
design.princessOfTsurugi: Count every opponent-team Spell/Trap in the three shared backrow zones plus the separate Field Zone; face-down and equipped cards count.
design.control: Capture controller team at trigger creation; physical owner seat remains derived from m0–m3 UID and is never rewritten. If control changes or source leaves after trigger creation, the queued effect still resolves against the opponent of the original controller.
design.lp: Damage applies to shared team LP; zero LP ends the duel using the existing winner/draw semantics.
